figures.title: Timeline of structural evolution and stability of 2D III-V materials predicted via DFT calculations.
The underlying building blocks discovered by density-based clustering algorithms.
LEGO building blocks to construct new structures.
Energietic comparison and regression analysis to identify the most stable structures and obtain physical insights of stability.

(a) and (b) represent the carrier mobility for TT III-V materials. The inset figures demonstrate the atomic structure of TT, as well as the corresponding x and y directions. (c) and (d) depict the contribution of the deformation potential constant to the carrier mobility, using the corresponding bulk material as a reference. The inset formula denotes the definition of the contribution.
